issue: Subtracts tax while parent approved method adds applicable tax under declared net/gross basis
resolution: Use structured discount and applicable tax sign/basis; EX-014 checks the declared calculation

issue: Subtracts adjustments as though all adjustments are positive issues
resolution: Use signed documented adjustment taxonomy; EX-022 retains negative adjustment explicitly

issue: Generic disposal_cost can overstate NRV deductions
resolution: Specify completion costs and costs necessary to make the sale under approved framework; age indicators separate

issue: Decision-edge labels/targets reverse decline and continue paths
resolution: Do not execute generated graph as authoritative routing; professional decision controls accepted/pending/declined setup

issue: Branches converge on ready and create circular EQR readiness
resolution: Separate completion restrictions, actual formal EQR outcome and report authorization; unresolved required concern prevents affected completion

source: Form4.6А/E2E A25 before-date wording vs verified benchmark
issue: Strictly before report date vs on or before report date
resolution: Keep professional benchmark on/before; earlier firm deadline applies only if explicitly adopted

source: Guide retention >=5 years vs Mongolian Audit Law12.5
issue: Guide minimum is below verified local ten-year workpaper minimum
resolution: Use applicable local minimum and longer restrictions; anchor remains D20, no automated deletion

issue: Question polarity, overlapping rating bands and5%trivial wording can be misread as universal rules
resolution: Question-specific meaning and actual firm method/approved parameters; no automatic significance/acceptance or statutory rate

issue: Copied opinion/basis wording can conflict with actual misstatement vs evidence limitation
resolution: Select report content from actual reasoned opinion and applicable reporting provisions; validate each section

issue: Percentage shortcuts/joint-arrangement wording are insufficient accounting conclusions
resolution: Evaluate actual rights/control/influence/arrangement and applicable framework with support

issue: Displays a confirmed price variance despite missing contract evidence; one source transaction is dated outside the displayed audit period
resolution: Treat the image as a superseded illustration. Preserve the actual period and source evidence; record a supported exception or missing-evidence matter without asserting an unverified contract price.

issue: The phrase no projection from this non-statistical design can be misread as a ban on projection for every non-statistical audit sample; the example actually selects targeted high-value/risk items
resolution: Distinguish specific-item selection from an audit sample. Apply the actual approved design, representativeness and projection method; do not infer population assurance from targeted items.

issue: Illustrative report adds an open-ended subject-to-basis-and-subsequent-amendments sentence to its opinion
resolution: Use the applicable approved report template and reasoned opinion type. Do not copy generated illustration wording into the report.

issue: Client-agreed proposal assumptions include reliance on internal controls
resolution: Commercial agreement cannot determine the auditor's reliance strategy. Assess controls and design responses from the actual risks, work and evidence.

issue: Old catalogues assign inconsistent meanings to PROCEDURE_TYPE_CODE and NATURE_CODE; physical text columns do not define approved lookup values
resolution: Specify actual procedure purpose, nature and technique in business terms, and confirm the selected code vocabulary before implementation. Historical catalogue labels are not approved code definitions.

issue: Parent/prior and child/current endpoint wording conflicts with another old current-to-prior relation proposal
resolution: Bind the actual current and prior engagement IDs under an explicitly approved directional relationship type. Preserve source-period origin and require current-period confirmation; do not infer endpoints from a generic label.
